title: Time controls: schema or transport?
description: Chess clocks, shot clocks, turn timers, game clocks. Are these part of the schema or a transport concern? Arguments for schema: time controls change the game (speed chess vs. classical), affect legal moves (flag fall = loss). Arguments for transport: timing is inherently a server concern, clock sync is hard, latency compensation is needed. Probably schema declares the rules, server enforces the timing.
close_reason: Schema declares time control type and timeout_result (game rule); server overrides specific parameters (seconds/increment) at room creation. timeout_result is an end_condition, timing is server-enforced.
